title: Skill Foundry map.json v2
description: The machine-readable skill-graph contract (foundry-v2 Wave 5). v1's free-prose relationship notes become TYPED edges (compose | import | augment) keyed by a STABLE ref; status is the closed PyPI Development-Status ladder; every skill carries the runner tier + an exact semver version; edges declare semver RANGES that the SEPARATE resolved-graph lockfile (foundry_map_v2.lock.json, the Cargo.lock analogue) pins to exact versions plus each skill's full transitive closure. This document is the SINGLE SOURCE for the closed enums and key sets: foundry_map.py reads them from here at import, so schema and validator cannot drift.

ref.description: The STABLE identity every edge is keyed by. It survives a display-name or folder rename; 'name' and 'source' may change, 'ref' never does.

semver.description: Exact semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH), no prerelease/build tags in v2.

range.description: A semver RANGE (the manifest-range side of the range/lock split): '*', exact ('1.2.3' / '=1.2.3' / '==1.2.3'), comparators ('>=1.0.0 <2.0.0', '!=1.1.0'), caret ('^1.2.0'), or tilde ('~1.2.3'); space/comma-separated clauses are ANDed. The lockfile pins each range to the exact resolved version.

status.description: Closed enum: the PyPI Development-Status trove-classifier ladder. Anything else fails validation.

tier.description: The runner's model-tier vocabulary (skill_runner.TIERS): HEAVY = frontier Claude seats, STANDARD = one notch below.

edge_type.description: Closed enum of relationship types. compose = runs the target as a composed dependency (jumper -> gandalf); import = consumes the target's code/libs (crucible -> foreman); augment = extends/specializes the target's behavior (literature-review -> researchPrime).

edge.description: ONE typed relationship to ONE stable ref. Exactly one 'type' string — an untyped edge (missing 'type') or an overloaded edge (a list of types, or a 'types' key) fails validation.
